LoadAudioAdvanced.description:
Load an audio file and output AUDIO.
• File path: any local absolute path (highest priority, no copy is made)
• Audio file: pick from ComfyUI's `input` directory (same as official Load Audio)
• Video files (mp4 / mkv / mov / avi / webm / flv / ts…) are accepted and the audio is extracted automatically
• Truncation: take a segment from the start, any middle range, or from a point to the end

inputTips.文件路径: Any local absolute path. Audio and video are both supported. When filled, it takes priority and no copy of the file is created.
inputTips.音频文件: Select a file from the ComfyUI `input` directory (used when File path is empty).
inputTips.音轨序号: Which audio track to use for files with multiple tracks (e.g. videos). 0 means the first track.
inputTips.截断方式:
How to cut a long audio file:
① Head segment: from 0 s, take Duration to take seconds
② Middle range: from Start to End
③ From start to end: use everything from Start to the end of the file
For ① fill in Duration to take; for ② fill in Start and End; for ③ fill in Start only.
inputTips.起点(秒):
Where to start (seconds).
Middle range: used together with End.
From start to end: the starting position; End is ignored.
inputTips.终点(秒):
Where to stop (seconds). Must be greater than Start.
Only applies to the Middle range mode; ignored in other modes.
inputTips.截取时长(秒):
How much to take (seconds), measured from the beginning of the file, so the start is fixed at 0 s.
Only applies to the Head segment mode; ignored in other modes.

SaveAudioPlatformExport.description:
Export AUDIO to WAV / MP3 / FLAC / OPUS in one run, with a platform compliance report.
• Sample rate / channels / WAV bit depth / MP3 bitrate / OPUS bitrate set to "Auto" follow the source audio parameters
• Directly connected to "Load Audio (Advanced)" for format conversion: when the target format matches the source and all parameters are "Auto", the source file is copied as-is (instant, no re-encoding)
• Multiple target formats can be produced in a single run

inputTips.音频: The AUDIO input of any audio output node.
inputTips.文件名前缀: A relative path saves into the ComfyUI output directory; an absolute path saves to any local directory.
inputTips.WAV位深: WAV sample bit depth. "Auto" follows the source bit depth (16-bit if unknown).
inputTips.MP3码率: MP3 bitrate. "Auto" uses 320 kbps for lossless sources and never exceeds a lossy source's bitrate; "V0" is variable-bitrate highest quality.
inputTips.OPUS码率: OPUS bitrate. "Auto" uses 192 kbps for lossless sources and never exceeds a lossy source's bitrate.
inputTips.采样率: Sample rate. "Auto" follows the source sample rate.
inputTips.声道: Channel count. "Auto" follows the source channel count.
inputTips.最低采样率: Minimum sample rate required by the platform (Hz).
inputTips.最低位深: Minimum bit depth required by the platform (bit); applies to WAV only.
inputTips.最低码率kbps: Minimum bitrate required by the platform (kbps); applies to MP3 / OPUS only.
inputTips.要求声道: Channel count required by the platform.
inputTips.文件大小上限MB: Maximum size of a single audio file (MB). Anything larger is treated as non-compliant.

LoadVideoAdvanced.description:
Load a video file and output VIDEO.
• File path: any local absolute path (highest priority, no copy is made)
• Video file: pick from ComfyUI's `input` directory (same as official Load Video)
• Supports mp4 / mkv / mov / avi / webm / flv / ts and other mainstream formats
• Truncation: take a segment from the start, any middle range, or from a point to the end

inputTips.文件路径: Any local absolute path. When filled, it takes priority and no copy of the file is created.
inputTips.视频文件: Select a video from the ComfyUI `input` directory (used when File path is empty).
inputTips.视频流序号: Which video stream to use for files with multiple streams. 0 means the first one.
inputTips.截断方式:
How to cut a long video:
① Head segment: from 0 s, take Duration to take seconds
② Middle range: from Start to End
③ From start to end: use everything from Start to the end of the video
For ① fill in Duration to take; for ② fill in Start and End; for ③ fill in Start only.
inputTips.起点(秒):
Where to start (seconds).
Middle range: used together with End.
From start to end: the starting position; End is ignored.
inputTips.终点(秒):
Where to stop (seconds). Must be greater than Start.
Only applies to the Middle range mode; ignored in other modes.
inputTips.截取时长(秒):
How much to take (seconds), measured from the beginning of the video, so the start is fixed at 0 s.
Only applies to the Head segment mode; ignored in other modes.

SaveVideoConverter.description:
Export VIDEO to MP4 / MKV / WEBM / AVI / MOV in one run.
• Resolution / frame rate / video codec / audio handling set to "Auto" follow the source video
• Directly connected to "Load Video (Advanced)" for format conversion: when the target format matches the source and all parameters are "Auto", the source file is copied as-is (instant, no re-encoding)
• Multiple target formats can be produced in a single run; no report is produced, files are simply written to disk

inputTips.视频: The VIDEO input of any video output node.
inputTips.文件名前缀: A relative path saves into the ComfyUI output directory; an absolute path saves to any local directory.
inputTips.视频编码: "Auto" reuses the source codec; if that codec is incompatible with the target container it falls back to the container's recommended codec.
inputTips.画质CRF: Constant rate factor. Lower values mean higher quality and larger files; "Auto" picks a sensible default per codec.
inputTips.分辨率: "Keep original" uses the source resolution; any other option scales to the listed size proportionally (no distortion, no cropping).
inputTips.帧率: "Keep original" uses the source frame rate; any other option outputs the given value.
inputTips.音频处理: "Keep original audio" does not re-encode; "Auto" transcodes when the target container cannot carry the source audio; "Remove audio" exports a silent video; any other option forces transcoding to that format.
inputTips.音频码率: Bitrate used when the audio is re-encoded. "Auto" picks a common value for the chosen audio codec.

截断方式.从起点一直到结尾（起点 → 末尾）: From start to the end (start → end of file)
